# Regulatory and AML Risk Monitoring Tasks

This document outlines critical tasks for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Monitor legal risks standard updates.
*   Optimize regulatory changes standard updates.
*   Investigate AML detection standard updates.
*   Conduct quarterly investigations of regulatory changes.
*   Update legal risks based on audit findings.
